Princeton PhD Student Detained in US for Visa Overstay

Eva Yi Xie, a PhD student from China at Princeton University, was detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents at a Washington airport. The Department of Homeland Security stated that Xie had overstayed her visa, with the overstay reportedly occurring in 2016.
